brief: Loomhouse - Winter Knit Edit (AW31). Objective: launch the winter knitwear range to existing customers in the UK and EU. Audience: women aged 30-55 who buy natural-fibre clothing. Key message: "Warmth you can feel, made to last." Deliverables: 1 Instagram feed image (1080x1350) and 1 email header image (1200x600). Usage rights: Instagram and email, UK and EU, until 30 September 2032. Mandatory: show the wool fibre up close. Deadline: 15 November 2031. Budget: GBP 8,000.
